text:
Avery: quick follow-up from today's all-hands  leadership asked for customer-ready one-liners for 2 items: (1) Console traffic controls (UI + API) and (2) Optimize recommendations (batching + quantization). Can product give single-sentence lines and main caveats?

Sam (Product): Console traffic controls: private beta mid-May, public beta late June; depends on quota backend cutover in staging (possible 1-week slip).

Diego (Runtime): Staging cutover at 4/5 services, health checks green. If we hit a rollback expect ~1 week delay.

Sam (Product): Optimize recommendations: internal alpha early July with a few customers, public beta mid-July; hosted-only at launch, Dedicated validation planned for August (Q3). We include confidence and safety flags if evals detect regressions.

Maya (DevEx): I'll draft a short FAQ + SDK examples (route-limits and recommendations API) by Monday and link it to sales.

Jordan (Sales): I'll hold outbound briefings until the FAQ is live. If docs land Mon/Tue I can brief accounts Wed.

infra-bot: Quota cutover staging status: 4/5 migrated, canary scheduled 2026-05-10.

Avery: thanks  please add these lines to the roadmap and tag owners so I can share with customers.
